capabilities: Render the whole vault as an interactive 3D graph in Layers or Core mode
Expand and collapse connections from an index note
Browse links as a file-explorer style tree
Focus a note to see its summary, word count and connections
Style the graph with the Obsidian theme or terminal colors
disambiguation: Despite the name, no machine learning is involved; 'neural network' is only the visual metaphor for notes and links.
extras: The manifest notes this plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view is 2D and offers no 3D navigation, layered folder view, or expand-from-a-note exploration.
summary: 3D vault graph visualizer that renders notes as neurons and links as synapses, with layered, core, expandable and tree exploration modes.
